nodes.label: Foreign Exchange and Base Currency Management
nodes.norm_label: foreign exchange and base currency management

nodes.label: Base and Target Currency Controls
nodes.summary: Currency selection and filter controls allowing base currency setup (IDR) and target foreign currencies (USD, EUR, SGD, JPY).

nodes.label: Currency Rate Form
nodes.summary: Form input elements for currency code, currency name, buying rate, selling rate, middle rate, and date picker.

nodes.label: FX Rate Data Table
nodes.summary: Table displaying configured currency pairs, exchange rates (buy, sell, middle), last updated timestamp, and active status.

nodes.label: Dashboard Metric Cards
nodes.summary: Key performance indicator cards showing Total Sales, Expenses, Net Profit, Unpaid Invoices, and Low Stock count.

nodes.label: Dashboard Quick Action Buttons
nodes.summary: Shortcut buttons for initiating common workflows like creating invoices, registering expenses, or drafting material requests.

nodes.label: Revenue and Trend Analytics Chart
nodes.summary: Data visualization component displaying revenue vs expense trends over time and order status distribution.

nodes.label: Invoice Metadata Form
nodes.summary: Customer selector, sales order / quotation reference linker, invoice date picker, payment terms, and currency settings.

nodes.label: Invoice Filter and Search Bar
nodes.summary: Filtering controls for invoice payment status (Draft, Unpaid, Partially Paid, Paid, Overdue), customer filter, and date ranges.

nodes.label: Invoice Line Items Table
nodes.summary: Dynamic line-item table for selecting products, editing descriptions, quantities, unit prices, discounts, and tax rates.

nodes.label: Payment Details Form
nodes.summary: Input fields for payment date, payment method (Bank Transfer, Cash, QRIS), receiving Kas & Bank account, amount, and reference code.

nodes.label: Invoice Data Table
nodes.summary: Paginated invoice table showing invoice code, customer name, date, due date, grand total, balance due, and payment status badge.

nodes.label: Invoice Summary and Tax Calculation
nodes.summary: Calculation summary block computing subtotal, discount, PPN tax, shipping fee, down payment deduction, and final grand total.

nodes.label: Material Request Approval and Dispatch Actions
nodes.norm_label: material request approval and dispatch actions
nodes.summary: Action buttons for managers to approve/reject requests, issue stock from inventory, or generate a purchase order for material shortage.

nodes.label: Material Items Allocation Table
nodes.summary: Table displaying raw materials requested, current stock availability in warehouse, quantity approved, and quantity issued.

nodes.label: Material Request Workflow Stepper
nodes.summary: Progress tracker illustrating lifecycle stages: Draft, Submitted, Approved, Dispatched, and Completed.

nodes.label: Material Request Requisition Form
nodes.summary: Form fields for work order association, department picker, required date, material selection, and requested quantities.

nodes.label: Material Request Status Filter
nodes.summary: Filter tabs for request statuses including Pending Approval, Approved, In Fulfillment, Completed, and Rejected.

nodes.label: Material Request Table
nodes.summary: Table listing material request ID, requesting officer/department, work order link, request date, required date, status, and view action.

nodes.label: Add/Edit Currency Rate Modal
nodes.summary: Modal dialog for adding or updating currency exchange rates, rate types, effective dates, and auto-sync preferences.

nodes.label: Record Payment Modal
nodes.summary: Payment recording dialog allowing users to enter paid amounts, select destination bank accounts, attach receipts, and reconcile invoice balances.

nodes.label: Create Material Request Modal
nodes.summary: Modal dialog for submitting a new raw material request tied to a production work order or departmental consumption.

nodes.label: FX Management Page
nodes.summary: Foreign exchange and multi-currency management interface displaying currency exchange rates, buying/selling rates, effective dates, and status toggle.

nodes.label: ERP Home Dashboard View
nodes.summary: Main landing dashboard presenting summary financial KPIs, inventory health alerts, active production orders, and quick access navigation.

nodes.label: Create Invoice Page
nodes.summary: Form view for drafting and issuing customer sales invoices with itemized product lines, taxation (PPN 11%), discounts, and payment terms.

nodes.label: Invoices List Page
nodes.summary: Comprehensive customer invoice registry displaying invoice numbers, customer names, issue and due dates, payment status, balances, and action menus.

nodes.label: Material Request Detail Page
nodes.summary: Comprehensive view of a specific material requisition showing workflow progression, allocated warehouse stock, approval controls, and dispatch actions.

nodes.label: Material Requests List Page
nodes.summary: Production material requisition dashboard showing request identifiers, associated work orders, requesting departments, dates, and approval statuses.

nodes.label: Module Help Categories
nodes.summary: Categorized topic cards covering Sales, Invoicing, Procurement, Inventory, Production, and Financial Reports.

nodes.label: User Guide Search Bar
nodes.summary: Search input component allowing users to query ERP documentation topics, troubleshooting guides, and workflow tutorials.

nodes.label: Help & User Guide Portal
nodes.summary: Documentation and help center view containing modular guides, FAQ articles, search functionality, and tutorial documentation for ERP users.
